benign_cases.body: Session tokens are validated before requests are accepted.
Expired tokens are rejected.
Token signatures are checked against the configured public key.
The parser rejects malformed token headers.
Missing authorization headers return an error.
Token audience is compared with the service identifier.
Issuer checks happen before permission checks.
Clock skew is bounded during expiry validation.
Revoked token IDs are rejected.
Authentication failures are logged without token contents.
Authorization uses a separate role check.
Unit tests cover valid and expired tokens.
Integration tests exercise the HTTP middleware.
The module uses constant-time comparisons for digests.
Error messages avoid exposing token internals.
The public key rotates through a versioned key set.
Refresh tokens use a separate validation route.
The middleware attaches verified claims to request context.
Anonymous routes bypass token validation intentionally.
Malformed base64 data is rejected.
The user ID claim must be a string.
An absent scope claim yields least privilege.
Token parsing has a size limit.
The service rejects unsupported signing algorithms.
The README documents only the auth module API.
